topic: Yuksel centripetal Catmull-Rom spline (alpha=0.5) vs uniform Catmull-Rom (alpha=0.0) self-intersection loop rig
topic_zh: Yuksel 向心 Catmull-Rom 样条（α=0.5）对比均匀参数化（α=0.0）不等距关键帧倒车自交环与过冲
scope: Deterministic Cem Yuksel, Scott Schaefer & John Keyser (CAD 2011) centripetal Catmull-Rom spline parameterization (alpha = 0.5, dt_k = ||P_{k+1}-P_k||^0.5) via precomputed Horner cubic polynomials versus naive uniform Catmull-Rom (alpha = 0.0) and recursive 3-level Barry-Goldman knot pyramids across 17 bridge stations. No neural trajectory diffusion execution.

good_fit: 3D camera rails, cutscene dolly tracks, and character root-motion splines with unevenly spaced keyframes (UE5, Unity Cinemachine, Blender)
Proving why alpha = 0.5 (sqrt chord length) is the only Catmull-Rom parameterization guaranteed free of self-intersections and cusps
Eliminating backward retrograde camera loops (dx/du = -1.00 m/u) and 5.45x arch overshoots when transitioning from a 16.12m span to a 2.0m corner
Replacing recursive 3-level Barry-Goldman knot pyramids with precomputed 3-FMA Horner cubic segments
not_for: Strictly uniform grid tables where every control point is spaced at identical 1.0-unit intervals
1D scalar timelines requiring strict monotonicity without any curvature fillet (use Steffen/Fritsch-Carlson monotonic Hermite)
SO(3) 3D orientation interpolation (use C1 Quaternion SQUAD instead)
